description: Schedule a signed webhook to wake an AI agent later: ISHOB POSTs your JSON payload to your https callback at deliver_at or after delay_seconds (60 s to 30 days ahead), retrying failed deliveries (1, 5, 15, 30, 60 min). Each delivery carries X-ISHOB-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 with the signing_secret returned once). Free status: GET /v1/alarm/{id}; free cancel: POST /v1/alarm/{id}/cancel. Charged only when the alarm is accepted. Paid ($0.001, x402).

callback_url.description: Public https URL that receives the POST

delay_seconds.description: Deliver this many seconds from now (60 to 2592000). Use this or deliver_at

deliver_at.description: Or an absolute time: ISO-8601 with timezone (2026-10-15T14:00:00Z) or Unix seconds; 60 s to 30 days ahead

payload.description: JSON object sent back on delivery (max 8192 bytes)

name: set_agent_alarm
title: set agent alarm
